summary: Sumitomo Mitsui Financial Group filed a Form 6-K furnishing the form of its 6.950% perpetual subordinated notes, together with Japanese and US counsel opinions and consents, under its existing Form F-3 shelf (File No. 333-276219). The notes are issued in global form through DTC, carry a 6.950% perpetual coupon, are subordinated, and are subject to Japanese withholding tax unless the exemption conditions for non-resident or designated financial-institution holders are satisfied. This is a routine shelf takedown of regulatory-capital debt by a foreign private issuer, not a special situation; the CFO signed the report.
